reason: The pre-cut-off announcement expressly covers repair after eviction or direct deletion, but removing a missing directory's name without checking its surviving child index makes subsequent deletion return success while leaving an index that deletion previously removed and that exposes old files on recreation.

N2 and N1 use the same removal and absence-return lines, are both fixed by preserving the parent name when a child index survives, and share the cause of treating a missing directory value as proof that its subtree is gone.

N3 and GT-s2 share the cleanup and UpdateEntry lines, admit the same fix of restoring membership or rejecting the pending write, and both lose listing and deletion visibility because an update recreates a value after cleanup removes its name.
